name: Revenue Grid
description_en:
Revenue Grid now presents RelationshipOS: a Context Foundation for captured activity and CRM sync, Motion applications for inbox work and scheduling, and Kora AI above that foundation. Its purpose is to connect interaction history with next steps. Homepage mock examples illustrate possible actions; they are not customer results or proof that every recommendation is accurate.

A pilot could connect an approved CRM/email environment, verify one meeting and email against the correct account, then ask the team to review a contextual follow-up. Check exclusions and who can see the captured material before expanding capture. This is a proposed evaluation, not an executed setup. If context is absent or attached to the wrong account, reconcile that foundation before trusting downstream outreach or risk signals.
description_zh:
Revenue Grid 当前以 RelationshipOS 呈现：Context Foundation 采集活动并同步 CRM，Motion 应用处理收件箱工作与排程，Kora AI 建立在此基础上。定位是把互动历史与下一步动作连接起来。首页模拟示例只是可能的动作，不是客户成绩，也不证明每条建议都准确。

试点可连接批准的 CRM／邮箱环境，把一次会议与一封邮件核对到正确账户，再让团队审查基于背景的跟进。扩大采集前应检查排除项和资料可见范围。这是评估建议，并非已执行配置。背景缺失或归错账户时，应先修正底层记录，再依赖后续触达或风险信号。

Check exclusions and who can see the captured material before expanding capture. This is a proposed evaluation, not an executed setup. steps.zh: 试点可连接批准的 CRM／邮箱环境，把一次会议与一封邮件核对到正确账户，再让团队审查基于背景的跟进。扩大采集前应检查排除项和资料可见范围。这是评估建议，并非已执行配置。背景缺失或归错账户时，应先修正底层记录，再依赖后续触达或风险信号。

items.en: Official pricing describes cloud, private and dedicated environments according to requirements. That does not establish customer-operated self-hosting rights or a source-code license. The linked technical documentation returned 403 in this research, so detailed synchronization recovery and API semantics remain unverified. A team needing reliable CRM history can shortlist this foundation; one needing only outbound email should check whether the context stack adds necessary value.
items.zh: 官方定价说明可按需求使用云端、私有及专用环境，但这不能证明客户有自营托管权或源代码许可。本次链接的技术文档返回 403，因此同步恢复细节与 API 语义仍未核实。需要可靠 CRM 历史的团队可考虑其基础层；只需要外发邮件的团队应判断背景体系是否带来必要价值。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The pricing page is quote-based. Context Foundation includes capture and CRM sync; Motion adds the Context Panel and scheduling, with Smart Sequences as an add-on. Kora AI includes Smart Sequences, knowledge and meeting intelligence; RelationshipOS adds further revenue and relationship intelligence. Self-service setup and basic support are included, while implementation, customization, dedicated hosting and specialized support may cost more. A trial may be offered; the page does not promise one for every buyer or an ongoing free tier.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 定价页采用询价。Context Foundation 含采集和 CRM 同步；Motion 增加 Context Panel 与排程，Smart Sequences 可另购。Kora AI 包含 Smart Sequences、知识与会议智能；RelationshipOS 再增加营收和关系智能。自助设置及基本支持包含在内，实施、定制、专用托管与专门支持可能另收费。页面说可能提供试用，并非对所有买家保证试用，也未证明长期免费层。
